title: The Lunez Massage (Designed by Zura Spa)
summary: Zura Spa's specialized pelvic, perineal, and external genital wellness massage — timed by service standard, not sexual response, with clear consent, hygiene, and professional boundaries.

sections.title: The Standard
paragraphs: Lunez Massage is a specialized Zura Spa wellness service involving professional massage of the inner thighs, pelvic region, perineal region, surrounding groin tissues and external genital area. It may be booked either as a standalone service or as an addition to a Full Body Massage.

Because Lunez involves intimate areas of the body, it requires an especially high level of: Consent. Professionalism. Hygiene. Client communication. Emotional boundaries. Time management. Respect. Therapist self-control.
Lunez may naturally produce sensual sensations or physiological sexual responses. However: Lunez Massage is a professional massage service. Its purpose is not to guarantee orgasm or ejaculation.

An erection, loss of erection, ejaculation, increased sensitivity, relaxation, or absence of sexual response should be treated calmly as a possible physiological response — not as the measure of whether the therapist has succeeded or failed.

sections.title: 1. What Is Lunez Massage?
paragraphs: Lunez Massage is Zura Spa's structured massage of the pelvic, perineal and external genital regions, together with surrounding areas such as:
sections.closing: The massage is carried out using controlled pressure, massage techniques, appropriate pacing, clear consent and established professional boundaries. When Zura training refers to the "prostate area," this means massage around the external perineal and pelvic region associated with the area surrounding the prostate. It should not automatically be interpreted as internal or penetrative prostate massage.

sections.title: 2. Standard Duration
paragraphs: Standard Lunez Duration: 20 minutes.
The average active Lunez Massage lasts approximately 15–20 minutes.
The complete process may sometimes extend to approximately 20–25 minutes where additional time is being used for the closing pelvic massage, waist massage, relaxation phase or approved stretching.
The additional closing period should not be interpreted as permission to continue indefinitely because a client has not ejaculated.
sections.closing: Lunez is timed by the service standard, not by the client's sexual response.

sections.title: 3. Pricing
paragraphs: Lunez Massage Only: ₦25,000.
Lunez Added to Full Body Massage: ₦10,000.
If the original Lunez session has finished and a client requests another Lunez session, it should be treated as a new service, rather than an unofficial continuation of the previous one.

sections.title: 4. The Purpose of Lunez
paragraphs: Lunez should be understood primarily as a relaxation + pelvic wellness + body-awareness massage. Its professional purpose is broader than sexual stimulation.
The intended outcome is for the client to feel: relaxed, comfortable, physically attended to, less tense, more aware of the pelvic region, and professionally cared for.

sections.title: 5. Benefits of Lunez Massage
paragraphs: Lunez works around areas that may hold muscular tension and have significant sensory awareness, including the inner thighs, groin, pelvis, perineum, hips, waist and external genital region. The benefits should be communicated as wellness benefits, not as treatment or cure for medical disease.

sections.title: A. Deep Relaxation
paragraphs: The pelvic region, inner thighs, hips and lower abdomen may carry considerable muscular tension. Slow, controlled massage may help the client:
list: Experience a general feeling of calm.
Feel more comfortable in the body.
sections.closing: Massage generally may contribute to reduced stress and muscular tension.

sections.title: 6. Support for Local Blood Circulation
paragraphs: Massage of soft tissue may temporarily increase local blood flow.
During Lunez, massage around the inner thighs, groin, pelvic region, perineal area, external genital region, hips and waist may contribute to warmth and increased local tissue circulation.
The professional wording should be: "Lunez may support local circulation and tissue comfort." rather than making claims that it treats circulatory disease.

sections.title: 7. Pelvic-Floor and Perineal Relaxation
paragraphs: The muscles surrounding the pelvis and perineal region may become tense. External massage may help encourage relaxation around:
sections.closing: The appropriate Zura explanation is: "Lunez may help promote relaxation and release of muscular tension around the pelvic and perineal region." Pelvic-floor manual therapies commonly focus on relieving excessive muscular tightness, which is why the emphasis should be on relaxation and muscular comfort, rather than unsupported medical claims.

sections.title: 8. Comfort Around the Prostate / Perineal Region
paragraphs: The prostate is an internal structure. However, the external perineal and pelvic region surrounding it can be massaged as part of the Lunez routine.

Massage around this region may help provide: a feeling of pelvic relaxation; reduced muscular tension; greater awareness of the pelvic region; increased comfort around surrounding soft tissues; and a general sense of release.

The proper Zura description is: "We massage the external perineal and pelvic region surrounding the prostate area to encourage relaxation, comfort and pelvic awareness. We do not claim to treat prostate disease."
The source material specifically distinguishes external perineal relaxation from claims that prostate massage itself treats prostate problems.

sections.title: 9. Relief of Muscular Aches and Tension
paragraphs: Some pelvic discomfort may be associated with tightness in surrounding muscles. Appropriate massage may help: relax tight soft tissues; reduce muscular soreness; reduce the feeling of stiffness; improve tissue mobility; and improve subjective physical comfort.
Persistent pelvic, genital or prostate pain, however, should not simply be repeatedly massaged. It should be treated as a possible health concern requiring appropriate medical assessment.

sections.title: 10. Greater Pelvic and Genital Body Awareness
paragraphs: Many people have limited awareness of how much tension they carry around the pelvis. Lunez may help clients notice:
list: The difference between tension and relaxation.
sections.closing: This contributes to broader body awareness and sensory awareness.

sections.title: 11. Support for Pelvic Comfort
paragraphs: Because Lunez works progressively through the inner thighs, hips, waist, lower abdomen, perineal region and external genital region, the client may experience: reduced feeling of tightness; increased relaxation; greater pelvic comfort; and a feeling of openness around the hips and groin.
This should remain framed as a wellness benefit, not treatment for a pelvic medical condition.

sections.title: 12. Support for Healthy Tissue Circulation
paragraphs: The genital and pelvic regions naturally depend on healthy blood supply for normal tissue function. Massage may support superficial local circulation and tissue comfort.
Zura should therefore avoid saying: "Lunez makes the genitals healthy."
A more professional statement is: "Lunez may support local circulation, relaxation and tissue comfort around the pelvic and external genital region."
That communicates the intended benefit without presenting Lunez as medical treatment.

sections.title: 13. Reduced Inner-Thigh and Groin Tension
paragraphs: The adductor muscles of the inner thigh may become tight because of prolonged sitting, physical activity, exercise, stress, or restricted hip movement.
Beginning Lunez around the thighs allows therapists to address these areas before progressing further into the pelvic region.

sections.title: 14. Hip and Pelvic Mobility
paragraphs: Where Lunez includes approved hip-opening and stretching movements, clients may experience: reduced stiffness; greater feeling of flexibility; easier hip movement; and greater relaxation around the pelvic area.
The stretching portion must remain controlled and comfortable.

sections.title: 15. Sensory and Sensual Awareness
paragraphs: The genital and perineal areas contain significant sensory innervation. Professional massage may therefore naturally produce: heightened sensation; warmth; sensual awareness; arousal; and relaxation.
Sensuality should not be confused with romance.
The therapist's mindset remains: "The client's body is responding to professional touch. This does not create a personal or romantic relationship between us."

sections.title: 16. Stress Reduction
paragraphs: Lunez may contribute to: mental relaxation; slower breathing; reduced muscular guarding; reduced stress; and physical calmness.
The overall objective should be that the client leaves feeling relaxed and cared for — not merely sexually stimulated.

sections.title: 17. Breathing and Pelvic Relaxation
paragraphs: Therapists may encourage clients to: breathe normally; relax their inner thighs; relax their hips; avoid unnecessarily tightening the abdomen; and allow the pelvis to settle.
This can help move the client's attention away from "I need something to happen" towards "I can simply relax and experience the massage."

sections.title: 18. Post-Tension Relaxation
paragraphs: Where a client experiences ejaculation or another strong physiological response during Lunez, the service should not necessarily end abruptly.
The remaining massage period can help return attention toward: relaxation; pelvic comfort; inner-thigh massage; waist massage; calm breathing; and gentle stretching.
This reinforces an important principle: Lunez is more than the client's sexual response.

sections.title: 20. The Correct Therapist Mindset
paragraphs: The therapist should mentally understand: "I am performing a professional massage of an intimate area. I am not performing a sexual act."
The therapist should never approach the service thinking: "My responsibility is to make the client ejaculate."
The correct mindset is: "My responsibility is to correctly perform Lunez according to the approved technique, timing, communication and boundaries."
If ejaculation occurs, it is a physiological response. If it does not occur, the massage has not automatically failed.

sections.title: 21. Lunez Is Not a Hand Job
paragraphs: This distinction must be clear to every therapist. Lunez is not:
list: Permission for clients to sexually touch therapists.
Permission for activity outside the approved service.
sections.closing: The fact that genital structures are massaged does not remove the therapist-client professional boundary.

sections.title: 22. Client Expectations Before Starting
paragraphs: Before Lunez begins, the client should understand:

items.label: The nature of the service
items.body: Lunez is a professional massage of the pelvic and intimate region.

items.label: The duration
items.body: The standard duration is approximately 20 minutes.

items.label: Possible sensations
items.body: The client may experience relaxation, sensitivity, sensual sensations or erection.

items.label: No guarantee of ejaculation
items.body: Some clients may ejaculate. Others may not.

items.label: Touching boundaries
items.body: The client is receiving the service; they are not purchasing permission to sexually touch the therapist.

items.label: Professional limits
items.body: Therapists perform only the approved Lunez service.

sections.title: 23. Active Consent
paragraphs: Consent is especially important during an intimate-area service. Consent should remain active throughout the session.
If the client says stop — stop.
If the client expresses discomfort — pause and clarify.
If consent becomes unclear — do not assume.
The therapist should continuously observe the client's comfort level.

sections.title: 24. Standard Lunez Flow
paragraphs: The general Lunez progression is: Inner thighs → Pelvic / groin area → External perineal area → External genital massage → Pelvic / waist work → Relaxation / stretching → End.
Where two therapists are assigned, both therapists should remain coordinated rather than performing unrelated movements.

sections.title: 25. Phase One — Inner Thighs and Pelvic Preparation
paragraphs: The massage begins around the inner thighs and surrounding pelvic area.
Where two therapists are working: one therapist may work primarily on the left; the other may work primarily on the right.

The purpose is to: reduce muscular tension; prepare the pelvic area; establish massage rhythm; allow the client to settle; encourage relaxation; and prevent the service from immediately becoming focused only on genital stimulation.
The therapists gradually progress toward the groin and surrounding pelvic region.

sections.title: 26. Controlled Pacing
paragraphs: Lunez must use controlled pacing. Therapists should not immediately rush into continuous genital stimulation.
The massage should move naturally between: inner thighs; pelvic region; perineal area; waist / hips; genital region; and surrounding tissues.
This maintains the identity of the service as a structured massage. The therapist controls the rhythm.
The client's expectation does not control the therapist.

sections.title: 27. Erection Is Normal — and Loss of Erection Is Normal
paragraphs: During the massage a client may: become erect; remain erect; become partially erect; become flaccid; become erect again; or experience no erection.
Therapists should remain calm, professional, and neutral.
Do not become worried because the client becomes flaccid. Do not interpret it as therapist failure. Do not suddenly work aggressively to restore the erection.
Bodies respond differently throughout massage.

sections.title: 28. External Genital Massage Phase
paragraphs: As the massage progresses, therapists may move into the approved external genital portion of Lunez.
The work should remain: controlled; massage-based; anatomically aware; appropriate to client comfort; professionally paced; and within the approved boundaries.
Therapists should continue alternating appropriately with surrounding thigh, pelvic and perineal work rather than making ejaculation the sole focus of the service.

sections.title: 29. Handling Client Expectations Around Ejaculation
paragraphs: Some clients may enter Lunez expecting to ejaculate. The therapist should understand the expectation without becoming controlled by it.
The mindset is: "I understand what the client may hope to experience, but my responsibility is to perform Lunez according to the Zura standard."
The client should understand: "Lunez may create sensual sensations and some clients may experience release, but ejaculation or orgasm is not guaranteed."

sections.title: 30. Do Not Rush Because the Client Is Excited
paragraphs: The therapist should not abandon the service structure because: the client becomes erect; the client appears close to ejaculation; the client asks the therapist to go faster; the client expresses impatience; or the client feels pressure to release.
The client's excitement does not cancel the standard. Continue the approved massage rhythm.

sections.title: 31. If Ejaculation Occurs
paragraphs: If the client ejaculates: do not suddenly terminate the massage; do not celebrate; do not react with embarrassment; and do not behave as though you have accomplished a competition.
Remain professional. The client should be cleaned appropriately and made comfortable.
If time remains, continue with calming massage around approved areas such as: inner thighs; pelvic region; perineal area; hips; and waist.
The client's reduced expectation at this stage may allow deeper relaxation.

sections.title: 32. Post-Response Relaxation Phase
paragraphs: Where appropriate, approximately 5–8 minutes may be used for calmer finishing work, provided this remains within the overall approved session framework.
The objective becomes: relaxation → muscular comfort → pelvic release → calm breathing → gentle mobility → professional closure.
Therapists should not continuously attempt to recreate sexual excitement after the client's body has settled.

sections.title: 33. Hip and Pelvic Stretching
paragraphs: The closing phase may include approved: hip opening; leg positioning; inner-thigh stretching; pelvic mobility; and waist and hip stretches.
Any stretch must: be explained; remain within the client's comfortable range; never be forced; preserve dignity and appropriate draping; and stop if pain occurs.

sections.title: 34. If the Client Does Not Ejaculate
paragraphs: When the standard service time ends, Lunez is still complete. The therapist should not feel that the service failed.
The therapist may say: "Sir, your Lunez Massage session is complete."
If the client expresses disappointment, explain calmly that ejaculation is not guaranteed.

sections.title: 35. If the Client Wants Another Lunez Session
paragraphs: Do not simply keep extending the massage. The client may book or authorize a new Lunez session.
Once confirmed, both therapists should briefly step out for approximately 2 minutes to: drink water; stretch; reset mentally; wash or prepare as required; and allow the client to relax.
The next service should feel like a new session, rather than an endless continuation of the first.

sections.title: 36. Restarting the Second Session
paragraphs: When therapists return: be calm; maintain professional warmth; confirm the client is comfortable; restart the approved Lunez flow; and maintain proper pacing and boundaries.
Never tell the client: "This time we must make you come."
The therapist should never psychologically assume responsibility for creating orgasm.

sections.title: 37. Other Sensitive Areas
paragraphs: A client may request massage of sensitive areas such as the chest or nipples.
Such requests should only be accommodated where: they are within the approved Zura service; consent is clear; the therapist is comfortable; and professional boundaries remain intact.
If included, the therapist should continue to think: professional massage — not romantic touch.

sections.title: 38. Client Touching the Therapist
paragraphs: Lunez does not become reciprocal sexual contact.
If the client attempts to touch a therapist sexually: redirect where appropriate, and calmly state the boundary.
For example: "Sir, please allow me to perform the massage. Sexual touching of the therapist is not part of Lunez."
If the client persists: stop → step away → leave safely → report → escalate.
The therapist's personal boundaries remain valid throughout the service.

sections.title: 39. What Lunez Does Not Include
paragraphs: Lunez does not automatically include:
list: Client touching the therapist's breasts or genitals.
Any activity outside the defined Zura service.
sections.closing: A client pays for the approved service — not access to the therapist's body.

sections.title: 40. Hygiene Standard
paragraphs: Because Lunez involves intimate regions and may involve bodily fluids, hygiene must be particularly strict.

Therapists must follow the approved Zura: handwashing procedure; linen-change procedure; client clean-up procedure; equipment sanitation procedure; appropriate protective / barrier practices; and room-reset procedure.
Any materials contaminated with bodily fluids must be handled hygienically and disposed of or cleaned appropriately before the room is used again.

sections.title: 41. When Lunez Should Not Proceed
paragraphs: Therapists should stop, refer or escalate rather than massage through situations such as:
list: Unexplained severe pelvic or genital pain.
Painful urination with fever or illness.
Recent genital or pelvic surgery without appropriate clearance.
A reported acute prostate or pelvic condition.
Any condition outside the therapist's training or authorized scope.
sections.closing: Persistent pelvic, urinary, erectile, prostate or genital-health symptoms should not be treated as something Lunez is expected to diagnose or cure.

sections.title: 42. Emotional Boundaries
paragraphs: Therapists should not interpret erection, ejaculation, compliments, client excitement, or sexual comments as evidence of personal romantic connection.
The therapist should think: "This is the client's bodily response to the service. It is not about me personally."
This protects the therapist emotionally and professionally.

sections.title: 43. Do Not Take Client Performance Personally
paragraphs: A client may: ejaculate quickly; ejaculate slowly; not ejaculate; lose erection; become erect again; or feel mostly relaxed rather than sexually stimulated.
None of these should determine the therapist's self-esteem.
Do not think: "I wasn't good enough because he didn't come." or "I am excellent because he came quickly."

Instead ask: Did I follow the Lunez standard? Did I maintain the correct technique? Did I manage the time? Did I communicate professionally? Did I maintain boundaries? Did I protect the client's dignity? Did I protect my own dignity?
That is how therapist performance should be evaluated.

sections.title: 44. What Good Lunez Looks Like
paragraphs: A good Lunez session is:

items.label: Structured
items.body: The established progression is followed.

items.label: Calm
items.body: Nobody is rushing toward an outcome.

items.label: Professional
items.body: Language and behaviour remain appropriate.

items.label: Controlled
items.body: The therapist controls the service.

items.label: Boundaried
items.body: Both client and therapist understand the limits.

items.label: Comfortable
items.body: Client wellbeing remains important.

items.label: Hygienic
items.body: Intimate-area hygiene is taken seriously.

items.label: Timed
items.body: The duration is respected.

items.label: Complete
items.body: The service has a clear beginning, massage phase, relaxation phase and professional ending.

sections.title: 45. The Wrong Lunez Mindset
paragraphs: The wrong mindset sounds like:
list: "Because the service is sensual, normal boundaries don't apply."
"The client paid, so I must do whatever he requests."
"Because the client is aroused, I should become personally sexually involved."

items.label: "I haven't come yet."
items.body: "Sir, Lunez is a timed massage service. Release may happen, but it isn't guaranteed. I will continue the approved massage within your remaining session time."

items.label: "Don't stop until I come."
items.body: "Sir, Lunez follows our standard service duration. If you would like another session after this one, another Lunez service can be arranged."

items.label: "Why am I no longer hard?"
items.body: "That's okay, sir. Your body's response can change during massage. Just relax."

items.label: "Can I touch you?"
items.body: "No, sir. Please allow me to perform the service. Sexual touching of the therapist isn't part of Lunez."

items.label: "Does Lunez guarantee I'll come?"
items.body: "No, sir. It may create sensual sensations and some clients may experience release, but it isn't guaranteed. Lunez is a professional massage of the pelvic and intimate region."

sections.title: 47. Client Expectation Management Begins Before Lunez
paragraphs: The best time to manage expectations is before disappointment or pressure occurs. The client should understand from the beginning:
list: What happens when the session ends.
sections.closing: This reduces pressure on both therapist and client.

sections.title: 48. Therapist Safety
paragraphs: No therapist is required to tolerate: unwanted sexual touching; force; threats; sexual harassment; humiliation; pressure to provide an unapproved service; or repeated boundary violations.
The standard is: state the boundary → warn where appropriate → stop if necessary → leave safely → report → escalate.
Therapist safety takes priority over completing the session.

sections.title: 49. What Therapists Should Do
paragraphs: Therapists should understand the service, explain it accurately, manage expectations, obtain consent, maintain professional touch, follow the established sequence, control the pace, remain calm around sexual responses, respect the time standard, maintain hygiene, complete the relaxation phase, communicate when Lunez has ended, treat additional Lunez as a new service, protect the client's dignity, protect their own dignity, report inappropriate behaviour and escalate serious boundary concerns.

sections.title: 50. What Therapists Should Not Do
paragraphs: Therapists should not promise orgasm, treat ejaculation as the sole purpose, rush directly toward genital stimulation, extend Lunez indefinitely, panic when erection changes, pressure a client to ejaculate, allow prohibited touching, perform unapproved sexual activity, engage romantically with clients, continue after consent is withdrawn, ignore hygiene requirements, hide inappropriate client behaviour, or take the client's physiological response personally.

sections.title: 51. Lunez and Accountability
paragraphs: At Zura Spa:
list: Client erection + therapist remains calm = professionalism.
Ejaculation + appropriate clean-up + continuation of proper relaxation work = professional response.
No ejaculation + service ends at the appropriate time = successful boundary management.
Client requests another session + additional service is properly authorized = correct procedure.
Continuing indefinitely because the client has not ejaculated = poor boundary management.
Allowing reciprocal sexual contact = serious boundary violation.
Providing unapproved sexual activity = serious conduct concern.

sections.title: 52. The Zura Lunez Standard
paragraphs: Explain → Consent → Prepare → Massage → Pace → Observe → Maintain boundaries → Relax → Close → Report where required.
Before every Lunez service, the therapist should ask:
list: Does the client understand the service?
Does the client understand the duration?
Am I approaching this as professional massage?
Am I maintaining the approved pacing?
Am I remaining within the approved service?
If the client's body responds strongly, can I remain professional?
If the client does not ejaculate, can I confidently end the service?
If another service is requested, will I restart it properly rather than unofficially extending this one?

sections.title: The Lunez Mindset
paragraphs: Lunez is massage. Lunez is about relaxation, pelvic comfort, body awareness and wellbeing.
Lunez may support local circulation and muscular relaxation. Work around the prostate / perineal region is for external relaxation and comfort — not the treatment of prostate disease.

Sensual response may occur, but it is not the standard of success. Orgasm is possible, not promised. Erection is a response, not an instruction. Loss of erection is normal and does not mean the massage failed. Ejaculation is a response, not the purpose of the service.
The client's expectation does not remove the therapist's boundaries. The client pays for the approved service — not access to the therapist.
Time, consent, hygiene, professionalism, safety and boundaries always apply.
sections.closing: The goal of Lunez Massage is to provide a carefully controlled, professional massage experience around the pelvic, perineal and intimate region that promotes relaxation, muscular comfort, local circulation, pelvic awareness and general wellbeing while protecting the client's dignity, the therapist's dignity and the Zura Spa standard.
